listing.name: Tornado Outbreak — tornado (sp00nznet)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project reaches New Game, saving, story, dialogue and controlled tornado gameplay in the first level at 10–16 FPS. A white transition then fails to clear. The campaign is not established as playable. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PS3 USA BLUS30371 disc; update/digest unknown.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: On Windows, follow the source build with your own BLUS30371 disc and decrypted EBOOT.elf. Run tools/relift.sh, then Python build.py, and start build/tornado with the documented PS3_VFS_ROOT, RSX_LIVE_DRAW and PS3_MAIN_STACK_LV2 settings. Keep required keys and decrypted inputs local.

warnings: The project reaches New Game, saving, story, dialogue and controlled tornado gameplay in the first level at 10–16 FPS. A white transition then fails to clear. The campaign is not established as playable.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
